theorem lg_target (x : ℝ) (h : x ^ 2 - 5 * x + 6 = 0) : x = 2 ∨ x = 3 := by
  haveI : 1 ≠ 0 := by norm_num
  haveI : 5 ≠ 0 := by norm_num
  haveI : 6 ≠ 0 := by norm_num
  haveI : 2 ≠ 0 := by norm_num
  haveI : 3 ≠ 0 := by norm_num
  haveI : 2 ≠ 3 := by norm_num
  exact quadratic_eq_zero_iff 1 (-5) 6 (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) h
